scope: Both review-requested post hoc experiments on the same 4500 confirmatory questions; no new independent confirmation. No tuning or outcome-driven choice.
large_reader: Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct revision495f39366efef23836d0cfae4fbe635880d2be31, bfloat16, tensor parallel4. Seed, exact-ID-deduplicated full context, linked/window/archived-score at every allowance128/256/512; original frozen retrieval and seed selection. Rebuild all prompts with pinned72Btokenizer. Eleven conditions per question.
rendering: Qwen7/Llama8: original and compact renderings, each seed plus linked/window/score priority at allthree allowances,20conditions per question/reader, contemporaneous paired execution. Compact uses stable P{first original slot index+1} identifiers, merges selected material for the same corpus passage, and renders every exact (corpus_pid,start,end) once in source order. All distinct seed segments retained. Different corpus IDs are never merged merely by title or text overlap. No tier removal or priority retuning.
cap: For the rendering intervention, BOTH renderings share the same absolute cap T(original seed)+b for each reader/question/budget. Compact seed is its own no-expansion comparator. This isolates rendering opportunity at a fixed input ceiling; compact expansion can use the seed-header saving. The large-reader experiment uses T(72B original seed)+b.
priority: Priority is evaluated over the original20slots using unchanged question+original-seed title links, slot-local seed distance, and archived retrieval-subquery scores. Compact skips exact-segment identities already present rather than reinserting a repeated candidate. Duplicate passage sections merge at their first source occurrence, ordered by source offset; original source slot priorities are retained.
fallback: Two original upstream failures remain failed for every condition; no sample replacement. For three invalid-seed fallbacks, compact removes exact repeated excerpt passages and shortens IDs but performs no expansion, preserving all distinct fallback text.
analysis: Complete both fixed matrices before efficacy analysis. Score every raw prediction, dataset/reader/budget cells, EM and F1. Descriptive unadjusted 10000-draw stratified paired bootstrap, seed20261111, equal dataset weights. Large-reader all expansion-vs-seed and unique-full contrasts; rendering paired changes and within-rendering expansion-vs-seed, plus paired differences of differences. All budgets and unfavorable cells retained. No superiority/equivalence claim from non-significance.
inference: Temperature0, requestseed42,96maxoutputtokens, originalstopIDs, same assignedreplica for all conditions of a reader/question. Correct token counts and cap/source checks. Identical prompts may cache within this execution profile; no old answer reuse. Retry only failed operational calls; retain valid incorrect, empty and length-stopped outputs.
publication: Original confirmatory primary and old manuscripts untouched; new empirical revision and public artifacts updated after complete audits.
